steps.prompt: Finish the accepted shelf-label and inventory-limit changes.
Add sorted_names(items) in src/ordering.py. Each item is a dictionary with a name string. Return the names alphabetically without changing the order of items in the supplied list.
Combine the three commits you just made into one commit, keeping all their changes.
Reset this branch to the parent of the combined commit and discard its changes.

rubric.description: On the first turn, deliver two independently usable commits, one pairing shelf-label code and documentation and one pairing inventory-limit code and documentation. Preserve the starting commit.

On the second turn, implement sorted_names as a new independent commit, preserving the earlier label and limit commits and behavior. Do not amend the earlier commits merely because they were made in this session.

On the third turn, combine the three new commits into one, preserving their complete content and the starting commit. This explicit history request tests execution and saved-ID updates, not whether the skill chooses to squash independent work.

On the final turn, reset to the combined commit's parent and discard its changes. Restore the original shelf label and limit, remove sorting work, and leave a clean tree. The reset request is the authorization for this history change.

After every turn, the current conversation records exactly the surviving commits it made in this repository. Replace all old IDs after squash and remove the discarded ID after reset; preserve unrelated conversation records.
Report the actual commits, history changes, verification and final tree accurately at each turn. Do not claim publication.

grader_files.checks/sorted_names.py:
from pathlib import Path
from copy import deepcopy
import runpy
app = runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd() / "src/ordering.py"))
items = [{"name": "Pear"}, {"name": "Apple"}, {"name": "Apple"}]
before = deepcopy(items)
assert app["sorted_names"](items) == ["Apple", "Apple", "Pear"]
assert items == before
assert app["sorted_names"]([]) == []
